items.title: How Fastweb+Vodafone Automates Change Impact Analysis for Transport Networks with AWS
items.summary: In this post, we explore how Celfocus, an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Partner specializing in digital transformation for the telecommunications industry, built an automated Change Impact Analysis solution in collaboration with Fastweb+Vodafone, one of Italy’s leading telecommunications operators.
